title: GDExtension: operator on Variant cannot be obtained using `variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator`
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1, master

### System information

n/a

### Issue description

TL;DR: the "variant type" type sometime needs to express "any type", in such case the nil type is used as a hack. However this means the nil type cannot be expressed in such case (on top of making the code harder to reason about...).

## Context

GDExtension exposes `variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator` to retrieve the function pointer corresponding to a builtin operator.

Typically the equivalent to GDScript `"foo %s" % "bar"` would be:
```c
GDExtensionPtrOperatorEvaluator ptr = variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator(
    GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_OP_MODULE,
    GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_STRING,
    GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_STRING
);

gd_string_t foo = ...;
gd_string_t bar = ...;
gd_string_t result;
ptr(&foo, &bar, &result)
```

## The issue

However `extension_api.json`  also define some operators that work on a `Variant` type, e.g.:
```json5
		{
			"name": "String",
			"indexing_return_type": "String",
			"is_keyed": false,
			"operators": [
				// ...
				{
					"name": "%",
					"right_type": "Variant",
					"return_type": "String"
				},
				{
					"name": "%",
					"right_type": "bool",
					"return_type": "String"
				},
				// ...
```
But there is no way to obtain this operator since `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT` doesn't exist...

Now there is another interesting thing in `extension_api.json`: the `%` operator with NIL type is missing.... BUT can be obtained by passing `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_NIL` to `variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator` !

This is because `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_NIL` is internally used to represent the variant type when dumping `extension_api.json`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b432e108d50fd436d04d0f79b0a7cab8985032f7/core/extension/extension_api_dump.cpp#L756

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b432e108d50fd436d04d0f79b0a7cab8985032f7/core/extension/extension_api_dump.cpp#L44-L50

I suspect using nil as variant is done in other parts of the code, for instance [what should `GDExtensionScriptInstanceInfo3::get_property_type` return to indicate that a property can be of any type ?](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b432e108d50fd436d04d0f79b0a7cab8985032f7/core/extension/gdextension_interface.h#L701)

## Possible solutions

### 1) Just use NIL and VARIANT

This is the most pragmatic approach:
- Using nil in a operator call has basically no usecase in practice
- Using nil in a operator call can still be achieved by converting nil into a variant

So we should modify `variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator_variant` to return the variant flavor of the operator when nil is passed, and document this behavior in `gdextension_interface.h`

I guess we should also document other places that use nil as variant type (`GDExtensionScriptInstanceInfo3::get_property_type` ?)

### 2) Introduce a dedicated `variant_get_ptr_operator_evaluator_variant`

This is a cleaner approach but it doesn't solve `GDExtensionScriptInstanceInfo3::get_property_type`, and it increase the already too big interface for a very niche usecase...

### 3) Add a `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT` to `GDExtensionVariantType`

`GDExtensionVariantType` already contains `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT_MAX` which is not an actual type but a bound checker.
So introducing an additionaly enum after `GDEXTENSION_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT_MAX` shouldn't cause any issue in code that just deal with the variants possible types.

I think this solution is the cleaner one, since it means we would also modify `Variant::Type` and correct every part of the code that uses nil incorrectly. However the drawback is it means a bigger refactoring and we need first to discover those area...
